description: This file defines the `BranchPruner` class, which manages branch pruning logic for spreadsheet formula calculations, specifically handling conditional branches like IF statements to optimize evaluation.

classes.name: BranchPruner
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and optimizing the evaluation of conditional branches within spreadsheet calculations, such as nested IF statements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BranchPruner with branch pruning enabled or disabled.

methods.name: clearBranchStore
methods.description: Resets the branch store key counter.

methods.name: initialiseForLoop
methods.description: Prepares the internal state for a new loop/iteration, resetting conditions and stack states.

methods.name: decrementDepth
methods.description: Decreases the brace depth count for the current pending store key.

methods.name: incrementDepth
methods.description: Increases the brace depth count for the current pending store key.

methods.name: functionCall
methods.description: Handles the start of a function call, specifically managing IF functions.

methods.name: argumentSeparator
methods.description: Handles argument separation within functions, updating branch condition states accordingly.

methods.name: closingBrace
methods.description: Handles closing braces, especially ending an IF branch, and updates internal state.

methods.name: currentCondition
methods.description: Returns the current condition's store key, if any.

methods.name: currentOnlyIf
methods.description: Returns the current 'only if' store key, if any.

methods.name: currentOnlyIfNot
methods.description: Returns the current 'only if not' store key, if any.
